name: Tsugaru Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of western Tsugaru: Cape Tappi at the Tsugaru Strait, the Juniko lake group with its 'blue pond', and the Iwaki coast.
notes: Managed by Aomori. The Juniko lakes and the cape's strait views are the highlights.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
